Good quality strainer. Use this for my basmati rice that needs to be rinsed before cooked. Makes cooking easier.Quality a+++++I have recently started to do alot more baking and also using a deep fryer for cooking turkeys, onion rings, etc. and also frying doughnuts.
I am hoping to open a B&B next year and need to try out many different receipes to see the cost involved and also the time required to make them. After all, as in any job, time is money. Another important consideration is how well things pass the taste test. Believe me, my friends are loving it. lol
It came to my attention after needing to strain oil and also flour and 10X sugar that I did not have a versitale strainer. I remember my Grandmother had several and used them often but her's either were to old or "missing".
After alot or contemplation over the various strainers available I decided on this one OXO Good Grips 8-Inch Double Rod Strainer . So far it has actually exceeded my expectations.
I have used it to strain the oil from the deep fryer and also to sift flour and also confectionary sugar onto Ebelskivers: Danish-Style Filled Pancakes And Other Sweet And Savory Treats for a finishing touch. I can not recommend the Ebelskivers high enough either. They are so light and airy and you can make them for any time of day meal. Do yourself a favor and check them out. Also, if you think you may like them, try the Norpro 3113 Cast-Aluminum Nonstick Aebleskiver Stuffed-Pancake Pan , works great and no mess clean up.
Anyways, back to the strainer.
It is a double mesh strainer which allows it to be so versitale. Cleaning is a snap by just rinising it in water after use.
So, in conclusion, if you are looking for a strainer I recommend this one. Granted it may be a bit pricey but it will definitely replace any need to buy different mesh strainers or for that matter a flour sifter. The size is also ideal because you can do so many things with it without it being way to large or way to small.This is a well-made strainer that has held up well over time. It is used often and goes through the dishwasher often. No signs of rust.
reviews_1s:
I purchased a 8" double rod strainer (after having a 6" strainer myself for years and was very pleased over it). When I received the 8" strainer I should have trusted my instinct that it was not properly made, the round strainer was already too heavy for the double rod that was welded to it. It wobbles every time when I use it (as opposed to the 6" that was steady and firm). Sure enough after a few application - the 8" strainer broke on the two points where the rod were welded on the round strainer. I find it really disappointing that Oxo have such inferior products (OXO product are not necessarily cheap but they last - and I dare say that over 75% of my kitchen items - from the meat tenderizer to cold brew maker heck even the funnel that I am using are Oxo products. One point - the rod on 6" strainer are stronger and better welded than the one on 8" which was inferior, thinner and the end are not as meticulously made as the 6" that was purchase years ago. Whatever happened to the premium products that OXO used to make? Very disappointed.The handle on this is not one continuous piece of metal, it is attached poorly and one side had disconnected within a month of use. The other side broke off today and now I am left with an unusable strainer.

For the price I expected this to last years. Big warning, do not purchase. The mesh does not seem to be connected well either.

For the time it lasts it is great, but I can't give a $22 product that broke in less than 4 months anything above a 1 star rating. Can't say I used it that much either. Disappointed because usually OXO is the quality choice.I love OXO products, but this one wasn't designed well. Overall, it is very good quality, but the handle is so heavy that the strainer tip is inserted in a bowl when draining. I have to put a small glass or something to prop the handle end, or it will tip over.The mesh is loose and does not maintain shape at all and the handle is very short. I have an old oxo strainer from like 20+ and it's great so I was very disappointed to receive this, there was a time when I thought oxo was a sure thing but I guess that time is over.I returned the 8” strainer because the hanging loop is not as shown in the website’s photos and it is too narrow, likely causing the strainer to fall into the sink when straining.

One website photo shows the strainer to be 8” and by scaling, the hanging loop to be ~3” wide—actually it is 1-1/8”. By contrast, the 3” strainer hanging loop is 1-1/4” wide.

Otherwise, the strainer is very well made and heavy duty.I bought this strainer almost exactly a year ago and it broke today, with the handle coming off.Bought this in Dec. ‘22. Used it a dozen times since. Washed. Dried. Was draining shell pasta for dinner and the welds snapped. WTF?Used the sifter less than 10 times and the spot welds broke.thought oxo was supposed to be a premium brand. then i ordered this item only to discover not only is is cheaply made - the handle is barely attached to the basket - but that it's made in china. never again paying a premium for a brand that sells out for a couple bucks.Majorly warped, cheaply made, doubt it will last long. Very disappointing as I searched forever for a strainer with fine mesh.
